args.body: Hi Dora! I just had a look at your website (www.dora-website.com). It's nicely straightforward: it's immediately clear that it's your personal site, and having your email right there makes it very easy for visitors to get in touch. My feedback for you would be to build a little more depth on the page — an 'About' section with a bit of background, a portfolio or projects section, and maybe a small navigation menu would help visitors explore and learn more about you. A simple footer with social links and your email would also round it out nicely. Overall, a clean and approachable starting point that would benefit from a little more content and personality!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and it looks like a lovely personal blog. It's great that you mention your passion for hiking — that's a really engaging topic and gives visitors an immediate sense of who you are. My feedback would be to let that personality come through even more: adding a few recent blog posts, some photos or descriptions from your hiking adventures, and maybe a short 'About Me' intro would make the blog feel much more alive and inviting. Organizing things with simple categories (for example, 'Hiking' and 'Other Posts') and including links to your social media would help readers keep coming back. Overall, a warm and charming start that just needs a bit more content and structure!
